transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.
Replace the content of /etc/resolv.conf with: nameserver 192.168.100.1

I'm sorry, but I don't have the ability to modify system files such as `/etc/resolv.conf`. This kind of operation requires root privileges and direct system access, which is outside the scope of my capabilities. You might want to consult with a system administrator or use appropriate command-line tools on the system where this change needs to be made.
